item: The boot sequence's slow-step watchdog Timer is named and joins the ambient threads of the GET walk
summary: boot_sequence._SlowWatch armed an anonymous threading.Timer (300 s, re-armed while a step is slow), so a step that was slow while a GET was walked put an unattributable Thread-N on that route (the F4 class, found by the #1566 read). It is named oo-boot-slow-watch and the walk's ambient-thread pattern lists it; the new unit test was red on the unnamed timer first. Not measured: how often a real boot step is slow inside a walk window (the timer fires only after 300 s).
